candidates.title: httpbin /base64/ script pages, 6-7 Jul
candidates.verdict: previously reported lead (Murmuration Jul 6), reproduced from the Wayback index
evidence: 64 html+script /base64/ captures on 2026-07-06, 61 distinct payloads, sizes 256 B-4 KB
payloads reference ntfy.sh (63), r.jina.ai (45), duckduckgo (42), allorigins hexlet (11): the swarm's relay toolkit
no matching wiki burst on any swept wiki (DSE shows only admin cleanup then)

candidates.title: Relay URLs and probier pages re-hit after the 4 Sep disclosure
candidates.verdict: not a new swarm: replay/crawl of URLs published in the collusion.wiki dataset
evidence: jqp.vercel.app, md.succ.ai: zero Wayback captures from 1 Aug until 4 Sep, then 239 and 77 in 4-13 Sep
jqp: 89 of 230 Sep URLs are exact URLs from the published dataset, 114 more share a rare dataset token (e.g. short-link slugs dated 260618)
probier: 219 distinct IP editors on 2026-09-07 (120 on 09-09), all on June swarm page names (epoch suffixes from 18 Jun), 192 backup-named; 0 relay links on sampled pages
consistent with crawlers/readers fetching GET-write URLs listed in the dataset, which the engine turns into edits

candidates.title: httpbin /base64/ script pages, 25 Sep-2 Oct
candidates.verdict: weak open lead (overlaps Murmuration's Sep 29 lead)
evidence: httpbin /base64/ html+script captures: 11 (09-26), 22 (09-29), 14 (09-30), 6, 6; baseline 0-3/day Aug-Sep; ~60 distinct payloads
payloads reference tvmaze.com (40), archive.org (33), youtube (11), shinyapps.io (4), webhook.site, ntfy.sh
urlscan anonymous totals for httpbin.org rise 9 -> 7 -> 16 -> 29 per week over Sep
no wiki burst and no new-account burst on any swept wiki in this window; could be one developer publishing pages

candidates.title: 39 base64 html pages naming cbs.nl, 9 Sep
